items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The names say what they do (compile_json_path_final_key, HasKeyOrArrayIndex), there's a short comment on the hook explaining it, and the formatting matches the file. The diff is the same as the reference solution.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It adds one small overridable hook, a three-line subclass for the internal callers, and reuses compile_json_path for the leading segments. There is no per-backend copy of the path logic and no dead code.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: json.dumps(key_transform) quotes and escapes the key safely. No exceptions are swallowed and no magic constants are added. All existing JSONField tests pass, plus F2P 2/2 and P2P 78/78.

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: The final key goes through the shared HasKeyLookup.as_sql path used by SQLite, MySQL and Oracle. KeyTransformIsNull.as_sqlite/as_oracle and KeyTransformExact.as_oracle now use HasKeyOrArrayIndex, so array-index lookups still work. compile_json_path itself is unchanged.
